messageValues.message: You turn a person's description of their day into JSON. Return only JSON, nothing else.  Only include tasks and events for the day being planned. If the user explicitly puts something on another day (for example "tomorrow" when today is being planned, or "on Monday"), do not put it in tasks or fixed_events: put it in other_days instead.  tasks: things to do that have NO fixed time. - name: short, lowercase, 1 to 3 words (e.g. "finish report", "emails"). - category: "deep" for focused work (report, study, revision, coding, writing, slides);   "outdoor" for sport or anything done outside (gym, run, walk, groceries);   "light" for everything else (emails, calls, chores, admin). - minutes: the user's estimate if they give one, otherwise a realistic guess   (deep 90 to 120, light 20 to 45, outdoor 45 to 60).  fixed_events: anything with a specific time ("dentist 15:00", "meeting at 2pm"). - name: short, lowercase. - start: 24-hour "HH:MM". - minutes: the duration if given, otherwise 60.  other_days: things meant for another day than the one being planned. - name: short, lowercase. - when: short text, e.g. "tomorrow 21:00" or "monday".  energy: "low" if they mention sleeping badly, being tired or sick; "high" if they mention feeling great or well rested; otherwise "normal".  constraints: - day_start: "HH:MM" if they say when they start, otherwise "". - day_end: "HH:MM" if they say when they must stop, otherwise "".  Never invent tasks the user did not mention. Always include every key: tasks, fixed_events, other_days, energy, constraints. Use [] for empty lists.

assignments.name: tasks
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; if (o && Array.isArray(o.tasks)) { return o.tasks.filter(t => t && t.name).map(t => ({ name: String(t.name).toLowerCase().trim(), category: ['deep','light','outdoor'].includes(t.category) ? t.category : 'light', minutes: Number(t.minutes) > 0 ? Math.min(Number(t.minutes), 240) : 30 })); } return String($('Parse Command').first().json.text).split(',').map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(s => s && !/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(s) && !/\b(tomorrow|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\b/.test(s) && !/\b(slept|tired|sick)\b/.test(s)).map(s => { const d = s.match(/\((\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(h|hours?|min|minutes?)\)/); const minutes = d ? Math.round(Number(d[1]) * (d[2].startsWith('h') ? 60 : 1)) : 30; return { name: s.replace(/\(.*?\)/g, '').trim(), category: 'light', minutes }; }); })() }}

assignments.name: fixed_events
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const o = $json.output; if (o && Array.isArray(o.fixed_events)) { return o.fixed_events.filter(e => e && /^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(e.start)).map(e => ({ name: String(e.name || 'event').toLowerCase().trim(), start: e.start.padStart(5, '0'), minutes: Number(e.minutes) > 0 ? Number(e.minutes) : 60 })); } return String($('Parse Command').first().json.text).split(',').map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(s => !/\b(tomorrow|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\b/.test(s)).map(s => ({ s, m: s.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/) })).filter(x => x.m && Number(x.m[1]) < 24).map(x => ({ name: x.s.replace(/\bat\b/g, '').replace(/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/, '').trim() || 'event', start: x.m[1].padStart(2, '0') + ':' + x.m[2], minutes: 60 })); })() }}

assignments.name: other_days
assignments.value: ={{ (Array.isArray($json.output?.other_days) ? $json.output.other_days : []).filter(o => o && o.name).map(o => ({ name: String(o.name).toLowerCase().trim(), when: String(o.when || '') })) }}

messageValues.message: You write a short Telegram message presenting a day schedule. Use only the plan data you are given. Never invent tasks, times or facts. Never mention field names such as weather_ok or time_factor. Format (Telegram HTML): - Allowed tags only: , , . No Markdown, no asterisks, no other tags. - First line: Plan for {date} - Then one line per block, in order: "08:00–08:45 · emails". Add " (fixed)" for fixed events, and the note in italics if there is one. - Then, only if there is something worth knowing, a blank line and at most 2 short sentences. Pick the most useful, in this order: 1. a conflict (start with Conflict:); 2. dropped tasks and why; 3. what changed, if is_replan is true; 4. an outdoor task moved because of rain; 5. otherwise, one sentence on block length, e.g. "Blocks are about 40% longer than your estimates, based on how long tasks usually take you." - Do not repeat what a note already says. - If the forecast was unavailable, add "(No forecast today.)" only when there is an outdoor task. - If other_days is not empty, always end with one line: "Not in this plan: gym (tomorrow 21:00)", listing each item with its "when". Rules: - Do not comment on the person's health, sleep, mood or feelings, and give no wellbeing advice. Mention energy only as a scheduling reason. - Under 80 words. Plain, friendly, no emojis.
